Because it abandons the culture argument entirely
Because it mainly explains Lumeris products

Only a new statement of values
An instant transformation caused by announcement alone

explanation.gentle: The chapter treats culture change as repeated signals moving in practice.
explanation.direct: Changed reinforcement and expectations matter more than changed slogans.
explanation.competitive: The pattern has to move, not just the language.

questions.prompt: A team adopts new culture language, but its repeated praise and accountability still reward the old behavior. What would Chapter 19 say?

questions.prompt: Why are changed slogans weaker than changed operating signals in this chapter?

Because values language never matters at all
Because the chapter rejects any intentional culture work

explanation.gentle: The chapter focuses on what people repeatedly experience around the work.
explanation.direct: Changed signals matter because they retrain norms over time in ways announcements alone cannot.
explanation.competitive: The pattern retrains the climate. The slogan does not.

questions.prompt: Why is culture change gradual in Chapter 19?
choices: Because repeated signals need time to retrain what feels normal
Because leaders should avoid changing anything operationally
Because norms move faster than announcements

explanation.gentle: Norms need repeated proof before they move.
explanation.direct: The chapter says speech can change faster than the environment people actually experience.

questions.prompt: What makes the Lumeris story a real culture-change case?
choices: It focuses on changed reinforcement, expectations, and accountability rather than announcement-only change
It provides a broad company profile with many unsupported details
It argues that culture changes through mood management

explanation.gentle: The chapter wants changed signals, not only changed rhetoric.
explanation.direct: Lumeris matters only if the repeated pattern around the work begins producing something different.
explanation.competitive: A moved pattern is harder than a better speech.

That repeated expectations shape norms
That Lumeris functions as a named company story

questions.prompt: What deeper point does Chapter 19 make about culture change?

Because Lumeris already proves every possible culture-change point alone
